formal_statement: ∀ (x1 : ℕ) (x2 : SimpleGraph (Fin x1)) [x3 : DecidableRel x2.Adj] (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x2 x4 → x2.support.ncard ≤ x4.size + (1 : ℕ)
plain_statement: For every graph G, a least circuit of AND and OR gates each reading exactly two earlier wires computing G's edge function has at least (number of vertices with an edge) - 1 gates.
title: A step toward: Part 2 of 2 of a proof of: Conjecture: circuits of AND and OR gates for the edge function of a graph with no cycle shorter than 5 have size linea
